name: Calculator
description: Provides a configurable block that displays an interactive client-side calculator.
project_description:
The Calculator Block Module provides a block to display a simple calculator on your website with predefined layouts where you can also override the default css layouts on your custom theme.

 The calculator is fully client-side: arithmetic runs in the browser via the module's JavaScript behavior. The block exposes a single 'Calculator Layout' setting (Layout 1 through Layout 10) that selects a CSS theme class on the rendered markup.

 We can also override the calculator template and css for the design layout with the available variables on the twig template. Copy the template file from templates/calculator-block.html.twig and place it in your theme's template directory, then customize the HTML and implement your own layout with custom CSS.

 Support: post bug reports, feature requests and support requests to the Calculator Block module issue queue. Installation with Composer: composer require 'drupal/calculator'.
